# Integrated DNA Technologies (IDT)

> Leading provider of custom DNA and RNA oligonucleotides, CRISPR genome editing tools, NGS solutions, and GMP-compliant manufacturing services for genomics research and therapeutic development.

IDT offers a comprehensive portfolio including Ultramer DNA/RNA Oligos, SameDay Oligos, HotPlates service, TruGrade oligos, and over 1000 oligo modifications. The company serves academic research, biotechnology, and pharmaceutical industries with products spanning qPCR/PCR assays, CRISPR reagents, NGS library prep, and CGMP manufacturing for gene therapy applications.

## Key Topics

- Custom DNA and RNA oligonucleotides
- CRISPR genome editing and guide RNAs
- Ultramer DNA/RNA Oligos
- SameDay Oligos and HotPlates service
- qPCR and PCR assays and reagents
- Next-generation sequencing (NGS) library prep
- GMP and CGMP oligo manufacturing
- Oligo modifications (1000+ options)
- TruGrade and Affinity Plus oligos
- HPLC and ESI-MS purification
- LabLinker order management platform
- Genome editing technologies
- Molecular biology research tools
- Cancer and infectious disease research
- OEM services and custom formulations

## CRISPR & Genome Editing

- [CRISPR Products For Gene Editing | IDT](https://www.idtdna.com/page/products/crispr-genome-editing): Complete CRISPR workflow products for genome editing applications
- [CRISPR Guide RNAs | IDT](http://www2.idtdna.com/page/products/crispr-genome-editing/guide-rnas): High-purity CRISPR guide RNAs and synthetic libraries for gene editing
- [CRISPR CGMP gRNA Manufacturing Services | IDT](https://www.idtdna.com/page/products/cgmp-crispr-manufacturing/cgmp-grna-manufacturing): CGMP-compliant gRNA manufacturing for therapeutic gene editing programs

## qPCR, PCR & Gene Expression

- [Predesigned PCR and qPCR Assays | IDT](http://www2.idtdna.com/page/products/qpcr-and-pcr/predesigned-pcr-based-assays): Predesigned qPCR assays for gene expression and genotyping analysis
